sources.integration_notes: v0.1.44: deterministic YAML workflows, Hermes provider experimental, MCP steps, human gates, web DAG dashboard, fleet token/cost view and checkpoint/resume. Evaluate as a runtime candidate, not yet deployed.
One Frappe CRM skill for leads, deals, contacts, tasks and activity timeline. Requires a real Frappe CRM site and role-scoped credentials; separate from HotelsVendors.
Self-hosted customer engagement journeys, email, push, SMS, WhatsApp and segmentation. Better suited to venture customer lifecycle messaging than JARVIS owner alerts.
11 agent skills: frontend design, browser, GitHub CLI, Postgres, Trigger.dev tasks/config/cost/realtime. Repo app is AGPL; check individual skill licensing and dependencies.
Durable workflow/task orchestration candidate for long-running missions, retries, schedules and recovery. Requires cloud deployment and operational configuration.
One executable skill plus CLI, Web UI and REST API. Requires Docker and Node.js. Preserve masked proxy credential workflow; legal/terms/privacy review before lead collection.
Recommended self-hosted provider gateway; one API across 100+ providers, fallbacks, retries, rate limits, virtual keys and spend tracking. Budget enforcement requires persistent DB configuration.
Separate MIT Rust MCP server exposing 40 Lago billing tools. Requires Docker and a Lago API key; billing mutations need explicit approval.
Additional MIT skill referenced by Marketing Skills after its old project-context template was deprecated. Maintains project-specific current truth, decisions, changes and scoped exports.

Provider discovery catalogue: README advertises 450+ models across 86 providers and 9 local/self-hosted tools. Provider examples are setup references, not a running router; quotas must be re-verified against official provider sources.
REST RAG and deep-research API with hybrid retrieval and knowledge graphs. Last recorded repository activity is Nov 2025; freshness review required before adoption.
Agentic research reference with cited retrieval and 28 tools; AGPL-3.0 and external search/data dependencies. Reuse workflow ideas or call a service only after license and provider-cost review.
SaaS application scaffold for future venture products; dashboard is described by its README as alpha/static, so not selected as JARVIS UI.
177 Agent Skills across analytics, channels, competitor research, content, SEO, paid ads, pages and GTM. Index all; load one skill at a time.
Usage metering, credits, entitlements and billing platform. Keep standalone; do not copy AGPL source into JARVIS core.
Privacy-friendly website analytics on Cloudflare Workers. Use for venture websites, not as API quota telemetry.
Current v2 workflow protocol, SDKs, conformance suite and reference hosts. The project still seeks its first independent host; use as an interoperability reference, not as the production runtime.

tools.capability: 3D globe visualization combining public satellite, flight, ship, orbit, quake, city and camera data.
tools.dependency_notes: Node.js 24/26+ per current project guidance; optional external data/API keys for some layers.
tools.permission_boundary: Public data only; verify source terms, camera privacy and location-data sensitivity before operational use.

tools.capability: 40 MCP tools for invoices, events, customers, payments, credits and billing analytics.
tools.dependency_notes: Docker image and Lago API key; analytics tool has an additional Lago agent endpoint dependency.
tools.permission_boundary: Read-only by default; require approval for invoice, payment, credit or subscription mutations.

tools.capability: Agentic multi-source search and citation workflow; 28 tool patterns in its README.
tools.dependency_notes: External search providers and rate-limited services; AGPL review required.
tools.permission_boundary: Research only; cite source and date; no unverified facts.

tools.capability: Branded document links, data rooms and engagement analytics.
tools.dependency_notes: Self-hosted Next.js/Postgres/blob storage/email dependencies; app license review required.
tools.permission_boundary: Confidential document access, expiring links and viewer-level permissions.

tools.capability: Browser automation through structured accessibility snapshots and browser actions.
tools.dependency_notes: Node.js 20+ and browser installation; project-scoped profiles recommended.
tools.permission_boundary: Use isolated browser profiles; no purchases, submissions, destructive actions or account changes without approval.

tools.capability: CLI, web UI and REST API for local business lead discovery and enrichment.
tools.dependency_notes: Docker and Node.js; full repository needed for scripts and references; proxy credentials must stay out of chat.
tools.permission_boundary: Respect source terms, privacy law and outreach consent; conservative crawl settings.

tools.capability: Current project truth, decisions, changes, uncertainty and scoped context exports.
tools.dependency_notes: File-first skill; never store secrets or duplicate live operational data.
tools.permission_boundary: Project-scoped visibility; confidential context excluded by default.

tools.capability: Customer journeys, segmentation, broadcasts and email/push/SMS/WhatsApp channels.
tools.dependency_notes: Self-hosted database and channel providers; separate from JARVIS owner-alert transport.
tools.permission_boundary: Consent, suppression lists and project-specific customer data.

tools.capability: Disassembly, decompilation, binary analysis and scripting across processor architectures.
tools.dependency_notes: Requires supported JDK and suitable host resources; integrate as an REA analysis provider when needed.
tools.permission_boundary: Authorized binaries and defensive research only; isolate samples and do not execute untrusted binaries on production hosts.

tools.capability: Discover free-tier and local model providers plus provider-specific API examples.
tools.dependency_notes: Catalogue is community-maintained. Revalidate provider tier, commercial rights, data use and quota directly with provider before routing.
tools.permission_boundary: Discovery only; cannot mark provider healthy or route without adapter verification.

tools.capability: Distributed Python compute, data processing, training and scalable model serving.
tools.dependency_notes: Requires a multi-process runtime/cluster for scale; not appropriate to install on the current constrained VPS by default.
tools.permission_boundary: Isolated workloads, queue quotas and explicit cloud-compute budgets.

tools.capability: Durable mission state, task queues, retries, schedules, signals and recovery across worker restarts.
tools.dependency_notes: Requires Temporal server, persistent storage, workers and operational monitoring.
tools.permission_boundary: Project-scoped queues and execution identities; idempotent activities.

tools.capability: Evidence-backed analysis of websites, desktop apps, JavaScript/Electron, binaries, Android packages and runtime behavior.
tools.dependency_notes: Node.js 22/24/26+ and npm; native targets may need Ghidra, Hopper or IDA.
tools.permission_boundary: Only analyze software and systems owned by or explicitly authorized for the user; runtime inspection requires explicit task scope.

tools.capability: Generate, read, edit and export presentations, documents, webpages and social posts.
tools.dependency_notes: Hosted MCP endpoint https://mcp.gamma.app/mcp; user OAuth authorization required.
tools.permission_boundary: Only access the connected Gamma workspace and user-authorized assets.

tools.capability: Keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits and AI visibility.
tools.dependency_notes: Self-host or hosted account; DataForSEO API key required for live SEO data and incurs usage charges.
tools.permission_boundary: Separate SEO workspace credentials; dry-run and cost ceilings for paid data calls.

tools.capability: Leads, deals, organizations, contacts, tasks, notes, call logs and timeline operations.
tools.dependency_notes: Requires a deployed Frappe CRM site and least-privilege user credentials.
tools.permission_boundary: Separate venture workspace; never reuse HotelsVendors customer data or credentials.

tools.capability: Multimodal ingestion, hybrid search, citations, knowledge graphs and deep research RAG.
tools.dependency_notes: Python service and Postgres/vector storage; freshness check needed due to old repository activity.
tools.permission_boundary: Project-isolated document collections; source-level access controls.

tools.capability: Next.js SaaS boilerplate with auth, database, payments and email integration examples.
tools.dependency_notes: Older repository activity; admin dashboard documented as alpha/static. Re-audit before basing a product on it.
tools.permission_boundary: Use only for isolated venture MVP scaffolds, not as JARVIS core.

tools.capability: Privacy-friendly self-hosted website analytics on Cloudflare Workers.
tools.dependency_notes: Cloudflare account, Workers and Analytics Engine; not suitable for upstream API credit measurement.
tools.permission_boundary: First-party website events only; avoid personal or sensitive tracking.

tools.capability: Python/TypeScript browser agents, CLI and optional hosted cloud browsers.
tools.dependency_notes: Python 3.11+ recommended; local browser or optional paid Browser Use Cloud/API.
tools.permission_boundary: Isolated sessions and credentials; respect site terms, rate limits and approval gates for consequential actions.

tools.capability: Repeatable technical SEO audit workflows backed by Semrush MCP data.
tools.dependency_notes: Skills alone provide instructions; Semrush MCP and eligible Semrush subscription/API access required.
tools.permission_boundary: Use only with an authorized Semrush account; review paid API access and usage limits.

tools.capability: Research code for decoding typed sentences from non-invasive MEG/EEG recordings.
tools.dependency_notes: Specialized MEG/EEG datasets and substantial GPU training; v2 dataset availability restricted.
tools.permission_boundary: Non-commercial research license; exclude from commercial JARVIS/HV products unless licensing changes.

tools.capability: Research top-performing mobile app patterns and build simulator-verified Expo/React Native screens.
tools.dependency_notes: Two skills; Appllama MCP account/credits needed for research features; app-design skill can be used independently.
tools.permission_boundary: Use for mobile UI work only; MCP account actions and generated assets require scoped approval.

tools.capability: Run GPU inference, batch jobs and compute-intensive workloads on managed serverless infrastructure.
tools.dependency_notes: Modal account, authentication and metered cloud compute; not a free local runtime.
tools.permission_boundary: Hard spend limits, per-project credentials and approval for GPU jobs.

tools.capability: Search models, datasets, Spaces, papers and documentation; run authorized Jobs and Sandboxes.
tools.dependency_notes: Official hosted MCP at Hugging Face; account login and selected tools/permissions required.
tools.permission_boundary: Separate read/search from repo-write, job-run and sandbox permissions; cap compute spend.

tools.capability: Serve models from multiple ML frameworks with HTTP/gRPC, batching and GPU/CPU backends.
tools.dependency_notes: Best suited to GPU-capable inference hosts; validate hardware, container and model compatibility.
tools.permission_boundary: Only expose authenticated private endpoints; isolate model repositories and monitor GPU resource use.

tools.capability: Stateful graph-based agent workflows with persistence, interrupts and human-in-the-loop control.
tools.dependency_notes: Python/JS runtime and checkpoint store; overlaps with Temporal at workflow durability layer.
tools.permission_boundary: Choose one production orchestration layer per workflow; keep project state and tool permissions isolated.

tools.capability: Training-free model-weight modification/abliteration experiments.
tools.dependency_notes: Requires local model weights and compute; validate model quality and license compatibility.
tools.permission_boundary: Research sandbox only; do not use to bypass safety controls in production agents or deploy modified models without review.

tools.capability: Unified API for 100+ model providers; retries, fallbacks, virtual keys, rate limits and spend tracking.
tools.dependency_notes: Deploy gateway with persistent PostgreSQL and optional Redis; provider API keys must be scoped and stored in a vault.
tools.permission_boundary: JARVIS protected reserve; agent pool quotas; hard spend ceiling; no provider key access by agents.

tools.capability: Vendor-neutral workflow runs, pause/resume/replay, packs and conformance contracts.
tools.dependency_notes: Reference hosts and SDKs available; first independent host still unproven.
tools.permission_boundary: Interop reference only until host passes conformance tests.

tools.capability: Wi-Fi channel-state sensing for presence, movement and research-grade vital-signal estimates.
tools.dependency_notes: Requires compatible Wi-Fi CSI capture hardware/firmware; not a software-only VPS install.
tools.permission_boundary: Highly privacy-sensitive occupancy/biometric-adjacent sensing; explicit informed consent and legal review required.

tools.capability: YAML multi-agent workflows, MCP steps, human gates, visual DAG dashboard, fleet token/cost view and checkpoint/resume.
tools.dependency_notes: Python 3.12+ and uv; Hermes provider currently experimental. Needs cloud service supervision and failure/recovery tests.
tools.permission_boundary: Isolated workspaces; human gates for sensitive actions; test before production.
